scope: Theme-wide snapshot-led visual QA on v4.4.0: correct verified typography/layout/spacing/component-density regressions without changing business semantics, UIF topology, actions or state machines.

authority.business: Product documents / BJ / flow / decision / contract decide business requirements, UX flow, business rules, information and user behavior.
authority.figmaDesignSystem: Figma Design System is the UI authority for components, patterns, templates, tokens, typography, spacing, state, interaction conventions and visual rules.
authority.htmlPrototype: HTML prototype is the design/verification medium and must implement both the product documents and the Figma Design System; it does not invent business rules or UI conventions.
authority.implementation: Production code decides the technical implementation.

figmaRuntime.notes: v3.13.0 live Figma DS Components page 505:5890 is UI authority for valuation redesign; no new core component is invented.
figmaRuntime.infoRow: 525:351 live 2026-09-10: 338x44; justify-between; gap 0; label left; value right-aligned; Disabled opacity 0.4
figmaRuntime.listRow: 525:519 live 2026-09-10: Default 370x76; Compact 370x52; Navigation chevron / Selection radio / Status semantic trailing; peer density must not collapse under generic touch-target rules
figmaRuntime.keyValueRow: 525:358 live 2026-09-10: 338x44 Default; Emphasis uses 12px horizontal inset, 8px radius, brand surface
figmaRuntime.toast: 526:4305 live 2026-09-10: 370x56 dark surface, 8px radius, semantic circular leading icon, plain close X
figmaRuntime.crossThemeReferenceRule: Mandatory: after canonical DS and Patterns/Templates, inspect mature Product UI in previous Themes available in the Figma file to validate grouping, hierarchy, density and spacing before implementing HTML; never assemble floating text+badge when an existing DS component expresses the semantic.
figmaRuntime.radio: Canonical VRadio remains available in DS but is not used to choose BJ14 costing method; tenant method is read-only.
figmaRuntime.select: Canonical single-select is used only when the user has a real allowed choice, e.g. BJ13 allocation method.
figmaRuntime.bottomSheet: VBottomSheet remains available for short contextual content; long direct-basis entry in BJ03 uses DS v2 / Form Sheet with independent body scroll and Sticky Footer.

notes: v4.5.0 reviews every active screen by screenshot and audits all canonical states. Fixes are limited to verified DS misuse/copy overflow/composition defects; v4.4.0 grouped-surface behavior remains intact.
